push.title: L 4-5 vs UK Chargers | You: 8.4 (4th best)
push.body:
Look at you, BellyTb1. An 8.4 against UK Chargers. That's the good stuff.

DID WELL
+ A brace against UK Chargers. Cool head, quick feet, ball in the onion bag.
+ 0.6 better than you usually play. That's the new normal, I hope.
+ 3 shots on target: +0.1. Good stuff.

WORK ON
- No tackles attempted (down from your usual 2). Training homework: Track your runner all the way into the box. Most goals against come from late, unmarked runs. Water the plant.
- 62% passing (13 of 21, down from your usual 75%). Real talk: Use the keeper and center-backs to reset. Recycling is how good teams find the gap. You've got this.
- Passes attempted: 21. Top-quarter midfielders live at 25+. Let's move in.
- Key passes: 0. Next target: 2+.
- 4-5 to UK Chargers. Chins up. Losses are tuition, and we're getting smarter.

Training ground: Defend the space, not just the player. Stand in the lane they want to pass into.

Lasso-ism of the day: The best ability is availability, and the second best is kindness.

You were a pleasure tonight. - Coach Lasso
